scope: Five native 4 KiB environments each run two 24-probe rounds. Original 23 probes pass; directory confinement fails in every round.
sourceBinding: Base plus exact changed probe inputs in the build receipt, not the unmodified base commit.

nativeSourceReview.openat2: DirectoryRoute::open_beneath -> bun_sys::openat2_in_root. ENOSYS/EPERM/EINVAL/E2BIG on both requested path and dot probe cache UNAVAILABLE and select plain openat. The latter does not preserve IN_ROOT/NO_MAGICLINKS. This source-path explanation is an inference consistent with observed unavailable raw calls and escaped private sentinels, not a syscall trace.

fchmodat2.discovery: Case-insensitive search finds SYS_FCHMODAT2 in src/sys/lib.rs. The previous lowercase search missed this direct call; that historical report is retained unchanged.
fchmodat2.internalPath: install/bin.rs chmod_on_ok -> sys::lchmod -> raw syscall 452 with AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW -> libc fchmodat on ENOSYS; chmod_on_ok discards the returned error.
fchmodat2.androidPublicPath: node:fs exports lchmod/lchmodSync as undefined when O_SYMLINK is absent. The internal node_fs::lchmod Android branch separately returns EOPNOTSUPP.

interpretation.blocker: Directory symlinks return a synthetic file outside the configured root but within the private test job. This is a directory-route confinement failure, not an escape from the Android UID or read of user data.
interpretation.controls: Regular/internal-symlink reads, literal and encoded traversal rejection, missing/NUL paths and FIFO nonblocking misses still pass. All six marker/target policy controls remain source-bound.
interpretation.cacheBoundary: openat2 is already unavailable in every native control; the native directory requests run before EIO/TRAP filters and may cache unavailability. The post-TRAP phase is not claimed as first-entry high-level TRAP reachability.
interpretation.noProductionClaim: Only unchanged experimental bytes were executed in this new suite. The matching upstream source alone does not establish the behavior of the official APK under these tests.
interpretation.remediationPendingChoice: Fail closed when constrained opens are unavailable (controlled directory-route errors, reduced functionality), or design and separately validate a race-resistant descriptor-relative resolver. No native fix or relaxed expectations is included.
